lines.1: 「This is strange. The colder she is, the more fired up I get.」
lines.2: Why am I so drawn to her?
lines.3: Did I fall in love without realizing it?
lines.4: 「You never give up, kid. Keep pestering her and I'll punish you myself.」
lines.5: 「As if a bird could hurt me.」
lines.6: 「Hah. I taught some students smoking by the station a lesson just the other day.」
lines.10: 「How long will you chase Inori around? You're starting to look deranged.」
lines.11: 「...I think I'm in love. At least, I'm not acting normally.」
lines.12: 「A student dazzled by Inori's body. She's sinful, almost as sinful as my handsome face.」
lines.14: 「Well... honestly, her body is part of it. I admit that.」
lines.15: 「But it isn't the only reason I'm drawn to her. That's true too!」
lines.16: 「Oh? I like your honesty. Then I'll tell you one thing.」
lines.17: 「Those two little girls in Inori's locket? One is Inori as a child. The other is Ikoi, her long-separated sister.」
lines.22: 「I'm testing your resolve. She clearly has a past. If you're still willing, do what you want.」
lines.23: 「Tch. You say that and dump the whole thing on me.」
lines.24: 「Birds must have it easy. No worries.」
lines.25: 「Idiot. Birds live in a harsh world. Every day is life or death.」
lines.26: 「If some fool casually says he wants to be a bird, I'll peck him on behalf of all birds.」
lines.27: Mr. Tsuchinaga says that and flies into the sky.
lines.28: ...Whatever her past, Inori is still Inori.
lines.30: I'm curious about that shadowed past, but I won't pry.
